label: Product mode: not part of the pre-registered experiment
title: Returns tote
use_case: Warehouse returns: a plastic tote on the packing bench has a hinged lid. Open the lid, put a small rigid carton (about 120 x 80 x 60 mm, 300 g) and a flat shrink-wrapped pack (about 150 x 100 x 20 mm, 150 g) from the bench into the tote, then close the lid.
headline: A two-tool head completes the task in 8 of 8 runs; the best single off-the-shelf tool in 0 of 8 runs.

plan.title: Warehouse returns tote lid open/close
plan.description: Open the hinged lid of a tote, place a small carton and a flat pack inside, then close the lid.
assumptions: Tote interior approx 300x200x120 mm, lid overhang 20 mm each side.
Lid lip feature 20 mm enables hook pull.
Carton and pack are rigid boxes as described.

steps.description: Hook the lid's lip and pull it open past vertical.
Pick the small carton and place it inside the tote.
Pick the flat pack and place it inside the tote.
Push the lid shut until it latched.

recommendation.label: Two-tool head: Soft arm + Suction cup

tools.caveat: Soft arm (approximation, octopus-inspired): a chain of rigid tapered capsule segments on spring-damper hinges, curled by a cable (a spatial tendon through sites) with a tension limit of at most 50 N. It bends in one plane (horizontal) and is rigid out of it; its segments do not collide with each other; a rigid post carries its root beside the part and the arm pulls the part against it, so the post takes part of the grip. Not modelled: continuum mechanics, material non-linearity, suckers, hydrostatic stiffening. Segment count sets how smooth the wrap is.

Suction cup (approximation): a compliant lip of rigid segments on a bellows spring with a limited tilt; the seal is a geometric test (every lip segment touching the face, part material under 13 rays inside the lip) gating a MuJoCo adhesion actuator capped at vacuum x lip area (at most 60 kPa). The lip must touch the face: no pull across a gap. Not modelled: air flow, leak rate, porosity, vacuum build-up time (the vacuum follows the shared close ramp and is cut the control tick the seal is lost), lip material hysteresis, peel dynamics beyond the contact distribution. The lip's friction is the part's. Treat suction results as a screen, then verify on hardware.
